title: You're not an impostor, you just started from a different line
why_read: A personal essay about imposter syndrome working abroad as a developer, with little technical content.
analysis: This is a first-person career/culture essay about the author's experience of self-doubt after moving from Brazil to work with a European tech team, touching on language barriers and cultural adjustment. It's a relatable read for developers from non-Western markets navigating international tech careers, but it contains no technical content about code, tools, or engineering practices. Interest here is purely in career-narrative terms rather than technical substance.
